Container.Name: ou-server
Container.Overview: OpenUnleashed server: one address for the OpenUnleashed game on Apple TV and Mac. Serves your own copy of the original game data (plus optional mod sets and an HD texture pack) with resumable downloads, keeps every profile's saves with version history (shared between Apple TV and Mac), and runs a lobby so network games can be joined over Tailscale.[br][br]Put the GameData and FEData folders (and version.txt, fe.txt) of your own copy into the Game folder. Set a Password and enter the same password in the game.[br][br]LAN / Tailscale only: never port-forward this server to the internet.
Container.Requires: Your own copy of Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (the GameData and FEData folders).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the game and the status page use.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password the game sends (as a Bearer token). Enter the same value as the Password in the game: Extras › Network, or the Apple TV Game Data screen. Use a long random string.

Config.Name: Game
Config.Description: Your own copy's GameData/, FEData/, version.txt and fe.txt (read-only).

Config.Name: Mods
Config.Description: One folder per mod set (GameData/, FEData/, SaveData/ inside), served overlaid on the original (read-only).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saves, save versions and caches. Covered by the normal appdata backup.

Config.Name: Save versions
Config.Description: Earlier copies kept per save file (plus one per day for 30 days).

Config.Name: Lobby timeout
Config.Description: Seconds without a heartbeat before a hosted game leaves the lobby.
